2、Hartnett为转向风险偏好设定了三个前提条件：油价（WTI）跌破70美元、10年期美债收益率降至4.5%以下、美元开始下行。周五收盘时，三项条件无一达标。

evidence.quote: The Justice Department announced yesterday that it had seized infrastructure used in a North Korean hacking operation called FaceStealer.
According to the DOJ, the operation has resulted in more than $400 million in cryptocurrency theft over the past 18 months.
The attackers first compromise legitimate accounts. Then they use those accounts to invite additional victims to meetings.
Sometimes it's a prerecorded video of someone the victim actually knows. Other times, the attackers use AI-generated deepfakes of recognizable people in the cryptocurrency industry.
The victim is told their microphone isn't working, or that something needs to be fixed before the meeting can continue.
Following those instructions installs malware.
And according to the FBI, they've increasingly targeted developers who maintain open-source software.

items.summary: Vitalik转为支持EIP-8288配合leanPCS：在内存池聚合STARK，链上只保留声明，使抗量子签名和证明不再大量占用区块空间。他认为该路径比需先确定ISA的leanSTARK更快落地。
items.author: VitalikButerin
items.new_information: 8288聚合方案及选择leanPCS的理由

evidence.quote: Once we go quantum-safe, signatures get bigger (65 bytes ECDSA -> 1-6 kB WOTS/SPHINCS depending on params) and ZKPs get much bigger (200-1000 bytes with groth16, PLONK, etc -> 128 kB with STARKs). This is unsustainable to put on chain, and 8288 fixes this.

8288 works by aggregating STARKs in the mempool. First, you as a user generate the STARK or SPHINCS signature or PCS opening (more on that last one later), and publish it. Then, each node listens. Each tick, each node takes all of the new objects that it has seen, and generates a STARK containing a list of "claims":

These aggregate proofs themselves get re-aggregated, and eventually you get to a single "master proof" in the block, that verifies that all of those statements are true. And so the only other data that has to actually go on chain is the statements (the (P, M), (X, D, Y), (X, Y, H) tuples I described above), not the actual signatures or proofs. This gets put
But most importantly, leanPCS gives you the same generality as leanSTARK, in a way that could potentially be implemented very quickly. And once we figure out the ISA, we can add leanSTARK later.
So there is a route to getting "the cryptographic proof singularity" much faster than any of us expected, and that route runs through 8288 with leanPCS.

INSIGHT: @VitalikButerin backs new approach to quantum-resistant signatures for Ethereum, combining bulky proofs into a single compact verification before they hit the blockchain, potentially making quantum defense practical without increasing fees or block space usage. https://t.co/qeqOjuYlUT
Vitalik is now backing an alternative method: “LeanPCS.”

In this method, the school agrees on one small shared checking tool and people bring whatever forms they like. This means agreeing on the checking system versus every form itself! Makes much more sense intuitively too imo.

but Lighter has public pools: a shared vault account run by a trader, where other people put money in and get shares. any account can create a pool. with an API key. no wallet signature. and that's exactly how the money got pulled out.

not mint_shares, but transfer in same_master_account mode: from victim account #714710 to pool account #281474976415757 in $1m chunks. to the sequencer it's a transfer between two accounts under the same L1 address, no L1 signature. it credits USDC to the pool and that's it. the share table is untouched.

evidence.quote: Backpack的DCO牌照获批范围包括全额抵押的期货、期货期权和掉期，以及保证金期货。这意味着它可以处理带杠杆的产品，配套初始保证金、维持保证金、变动保证金和违约管理机制。DCM牌照则解决了产品能不能挂出来的问题。集齐这两张牌照后，Backpack就能够在自己的交易所上线永续合约，并在自己的清算所里完成清结算。
对比 Coinbase，两边现在的牌照配置已经非常接近：Coinbase拥有交易所、期货经纪商和自有清算所，是目前少数跑通完整链条的平台。但Coinbase的DCO牌照范围仅限全额抵押产品，杠杆相关清算仍需依赖外部伙伴。而Backpack的清算所直接获准保证金期货这比Coinbase的DCO牌照获批范围大得多，这是少有的获准清算保证金期货（margined futures）的新清算所。
The CFTC officially registered Backpack Clearing (TLD Clearing) as a Derivatives Clearing Organization.
Most new DCOs this year (including Coinbase) only got fully collateralized.
@Backpack is one of the very few approved for actual margined futures — the key ingredient for real regulated perpetual futures in the US.
比较少见的是，Backpack 的清算所获准了做带杠杆的期货，这使得交易员仅需一部分保证金，就能开更大的仓位，而不是全额保证金杠杆。

items.summary: Castle报告称，过去12个月加密协议收入约137亿美元。剔除稳定币发行商后，前10大协议占47%的收入和73%的持币人收益，但多数赛道龙头代币仍跑输BTC，报告认为协议收入不必然转化为持币人收益。
items.author: wublockchain12
items.new_information: 137亿美元收入高度集中，龙头代币仍多跑输BTC

evidence.quote: 吴说获悉，加密研究机构 Castle 发布报告指出，过去 12 个月加密协议累计产生约 137 亿美元收入。剔除稳定币发行商后，前 10 大协议贡献 47%的协议收入，占据 73%的代币持有人收益。各细分赛道前两大协议至少占据 52%的手续费收入，部分赛道超过 90%。其中，Hyperliquid 年化手续费收入约 8.95 亿美元，Uniswap 占近 30 天现货 DEX 交易量的 25%。尽管协议收入高度集中，多数赛道龙头代币仍跑输 BTC。报告认为，协议收入并不必然转化为代币持有人收益，代币表现还取决于价值捕获机制、代币发行、未来市场空间及市场叙事。https://t.co/bJQh3cos5Y

items.author: AndyJYGood68
items.new_information: 给出波场与USDT主导稳定币支付的份额数据

evidence.quote: 但我是真的在做加密支付，感受是USDC 在支付领域的真实 adoption，被圈内人严重高估了，虽然我不喜欢孙哥，但TRON的基本面好太多了。

第四，关于usdc说几个反常识的数据。波场上流通的 USDT 大约 920 亿，以太坊大约 668 亿，波场多一些但你要明白tron上钱是以支付转账主导的，eth上是以defi投资生态主导的。从支付角度看，两者差距要大得多大得：2026 年，波场占稳定币支付金额约 66.6%，以太坊主网只有约 6.6%，差了 10 倍。即便把以太坊和它的 EVM 二层加在一起，也就十几个点，还是远被波场吊打。同期 USDT 贡献了约 84% 的支付金额，USDC 只有约 12%。
但如果你靠着 Circle 基本面给自己洗脑、动不动就 All in，来推导它会发展得很好，我并不认可。单从现在我对支付行业的体感，从基本面看，我觉得tron比 Circle 更牛逼。
